system.description:
You focus your chakra and inject it into your weapon. As a part of the activation of this jutsu make a melee taijutsu attack. On a hit, you deal your [Weapon’s damage] + 4d6.

Chain 2: On a hit, you coat your weapon in the blood of your opponent. For the duration, your weapon deals 2d6 bonus Necrotic damage on a hit, twice per turn and once per turn, triggers all Bleed ranks conditional damage a creature has.

Chain 3: On a hit, you coat your weapon in the blood of your opponent. For the duration, your weapon deals 2d6 bonus Necrotic damage on a hit, twice per turn, and once per turn, on a hit, affected creatures must make a Strength saving throw, gaining a rank of Weakened on a failed save.
